questions.prompt: The most important habit for untrusted input is…

options.c: pass it as data/arguments to a program, never build a shell string it can break out of

questions.prompt: An allowlist (case $x in *[!a-z]*) reject) beats trying to strip out bad characters because…

options.a: it accepts only known-good and rejects everything else, so an unforeseen attack is rejected by default

questions.prompt: grep -F -- "$x" file is fully defended because…

options.b: -F treats $x as a literal (no regex injection), -- ends options (no flag injection), "$x" is quoted (no word-splitting)
